title: Breaded, Fried, Softly Spiced Tofu
description: This tofu recipe is completely gorgeous. Tofu is soaked in vegetable broth, then breaded with flour, sage, and cayenne, and deep fried. Serve with a relish or a dip of some sort (I love this with plain yogurt mixed with eggplant brinjal).
ingredients: 1 (16 ounce) package extra-firm tofu, drained and pressed

steps.text: Cut pressed tofu into 1/2-inch thick slices; then cut again into 1/2-inch wide sticks. Place tofu in a bowl, and pour broth over the top. Set aside to soak.
In a separate bowl, stir together flour, yeast, salt, pepper, sage, and cayenne.
Warm oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Remove tofu sticks from broth, and squeeze most (but not all) of the liquid from them. Roll sticks in breading. (You may have to roll sticks twice to end up with a fairly dry outer layer of breading.) Place tofu in hot oil; fry until crisp and browned on all sides. Add more oil if necessary.

video.description: This tofu recipe is all-around gorgeous. The crust on the tofu is tasty and the texture is crisp and firm. Serve with a dip or a sauce, and pair with your favorite vegetables! Cumin-scented rice and garlic broccoli would be a beautiful addition for this wholesome meal.
